title: Austin's Air Force Base Water and Land Rights
summary:
*   **Expanded Utilities for Bergstrom Air Force Base:** The city approved a contract to provide expanded water and new sewerage services to the growing Bergstrom Air Force Base and its related housing developments.
*   **New Utility Rates for the Base:** The agreement ensured Bergstrom Air Force Base would pay the city's current, increased water rates and newly implemented sewer service fees, replacing an older contract that did not include sewer charges.
*   **City Claims Land Ownership:** Despite entering the service contract, city leaders formally asserted their position that the equitable title to the land occupied by Bergstrom Air Force Base rightfully belongs to the City of Austin.

NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
TO THE MEMBERS OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF AUSTIN: Notice is hereby given that a
special meeting of the City Council of the City of Austin will be held on the 27th day of
June, 1951, at the Municipal Building, Eighth and Colorado Streets, in Austin, Texas, at
8:30 o'clock P. M. for the purpose of considering a proposed contract between the City of
Austin and the United States of America, for water and sewerage service to Bergstrom Air
Force Base, and to consider authorizing the City Manager to enter into such contract on
behalf of the City of Austin.
Dated this the 27th day of June, 1951.

We, the undersigned members of the City Council, hereby accept service of the foregoing
notice, waiving any and all irregularities in such service and such notice, and consent
and agree that said City Council shall meet at the time and place therein named, and for
the purposes therein stated.
(S) W. S. Drake, Jr.
(S) Ben White
(S) Mrs. Stuart Long
The City Manager explained with the expansion of Bergstrom Field, they needed more water
than the eight inch line would furnish. Also with the housing project, the matter of sewer
lines came into the picture. He stated the water would be at our regular rate, with the
rate increase effective. In the original contract, the old water rate was specified and no
charge for sewer; but now, it is agreed they will start paying on the new rate.

Officer) in accordance with the terms and provisions of a certain contract No. AF 41 (007)
-97 for water and sewerage service to be furnished by the City of Austin to Bergstrom Air
Force Base, copy of which is attached to this Resolution, and marked by the City Clerk for
